# windows-scm

> Safe Rust workflows for the local Windows Service Control Manager: service
> enumeration, typed access, status, control, creation, and deletion.

- [README](https://github.com/icedracon/windows-scm/blob/main/README.md)
- [API documentation](https://docs.rs/windows-scm)
- [Ecosystem map](https://github.com/icedracon/win32-min/blob/master/ECOSYSTEM.md)
- [ABI foundation](https://github.com/icedracon/win32-min)

The crate owns SCM and service handles and closes them on drop. It targets the
local SCM API and does not implement remote SCMR/DCERPC. Configuration-query
and configuration-change helpers remain outside the current safe surface.
